purpose: Drei Ideen und Umsetzungen für den zweiten, alten Cenyric-Kater der Tiefenwyrm
userRequirements: Verblasste orange Tigerzeichnung und weißer Bauch

variants.title: 1 · Salzmähne
variants.idea: Kräftiger alter Kater mit breitem kantigem Kopf, ausgefranstem weißem Halskragen und bernsteinfarbenem gesundem Auge.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: fantasy animal companion portrait for Aleria, second ship cat of Idwal Draig's crew aboard the medieval cog Tiefenwyrm. One alternative design of the SAME requested elderly male Cenyric companion, not three cats in one picture.
Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Primary request: ONE visibly OLD, tough, hardened, stoic male domestic ship cat standing PROUDLY, with an angular mature face and a distinct natural MANE-LIKE FUR RUFF around neck and upper chest. He has endured many years, looks seasoned and self-possessed, and remains sturdy and capable. Age is communicated by faded coat color, a broad mature feline muzzle, angular cheek structure, coarse uneven fur tufts and long pale whiskers. Upright neck, lifted chin, steady planted paws, healthy weight, muscle and sinew, quiet alertness. CLOSED mouth and a grave, composed feline expression.
Critical breed markings: PALE ORANGE GINGER TABBY, visibly faded desaturated apricot-orange base and muted deeper ORANGE stripes, with a broad WHITE BELLY, white lower chest and white chin. He must still unmistakably read as an ORANGE TABBY AND WHITE cat, not a gray or brown tabby. White fur may be ivory in the light, but the white belly must be clearly distinct from the faded orange back and sides. Natural short-to-medium body fur with a longer ragged, mane-like ruff, not a full longhair show cat.
Critical eye detail: BOTH eyes visible. EXACTLY ONE eye is clouded with a milky blue-gray opaque lens, its pupil barely discernible. The other eye is clear, focused and observant. This is an old, healed cloudy eye without redness or open wound. No eyepatch.
Composition: one full-body quadrupedal domestic tomcat, including all four paws, ears, neck ruff and entire tail, large clear foreground subject occupying about 75 percent of portrait height. Three-quarter frontal or side view arranged so BOTH EYES and the WHITE chest and belly underside can be seen. The mane is a believable feline neck ruff, not a human beard or lion costume. Simple medieval wooden ship deck context, quiet blue sea and pale sky beyond, warm clear daylight, restrained background, very few props. Crisp confident anime contours, flat clean cel shading, simplified stylized fur masses. A robust, dignified natural cat, not a humanoid.
Avoid: kitten or young cat face, enormous cute eyes, grin, smug smile, playful smirk, comedy pose, sleepiness, drooping ears, slumped posture, frailty, gauntness, sickness, sadness, pitiful expression, aggressive snarling, blood, wounds, matted neglected fur, clothes, collar, hat, bandana, eyepatch, weapons, humans, extra animals, fantasy lion anatomy, huge lion body, text, watermark, frame, panels, collage, photorealistic fur, watercolor or painterly rendering.
Variant 1 — SALT MANE: sturdy medium-large old tomcat with broad shoulders, a strong compact body and a square mature feline muzzle. Faded light ginger orange tabby fur, ghostlike orange stripes still clear, especially on legs and tail. Broad WHITE BELLY and a thick WHITE-to-IVORY mane-like ruff, rough and uneven with pointed outward tufts around cheeks and neck; a few lighter hairs at the muzzle. One cloudy milky blue-gray eye, the clear eye a muted AMBER. Standing squarely and proudly on a low weathered timber platform on deck, all paws firmly planted, chest forward, neck upright, head slightly raised and turned only a little toward the viewer so both eyes are visible. Tail held low in a relaxed strong curve, not drooping limply. The expression is entirely stoic and fearless, a seasoned shipboard veteran who observes everything. Broad blue sea and simple wood behind, no additional props.
